invariant.portable_principle: A valid decision:NNNN comment reference remains visible in final audit evidence and an orphan is reported only when its ADR id does not resolve; report artifacts are written only to an output directory resolved inside the project root.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Python uses tokenize comments; Markdown and HTML retain the established # decision:NNNN form; registry/link outputs preserve the existing audit behavior.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: A bundled Node helper resolves the host's project-local TypeScript Compiler API, rejects parse errors, excludes compiler-recognized literal and JSX text ranges, and attributes line, block, and JSDoc decision comments from remaining code trivia.

reference_repairs: Replaced instruction-only grep and uninstalled repository-script dependence with a selected-skill stdlib audit runner.
Added final artifact evidence for resolved references rather than keeping only orphan rows.
Anchored all exclusions to project-root-relative paths so direct excluded targets cannot bypass them.
Matched current repository registry-audit diagnostics and link-check text in a direct compatibility replay.
Recognized JSX fragments and ignored comment-shaped fragment/element text while retaining real JSX-expression comments.
Made JSX tag probing quote/expression aware so commas inside quoted attributes do not masquerade as TypeScript generic delimiters.
Added expression-prefix regex contexts including typeof, void, and instanceof, with a member-access guard.
Tracked nested type-argument angle depth through generic JSX opening tags so an inner generic close cannot consume following code as JSX text.
Replaced the lexical TypeScript/TSX scanner with a host-local Compiler API helper so the language parser owns JSX, regex, string, template, and generic syntax boundaries.
Resolved --output-dir against the resolved project root and rejected absolute, parent-traversal, final-symlink, and ancestor-symlink escapes before mkdir or artifact writes.
